answers.workaround:
I'm not sure. 

One method I think that exists is doing an iteration of a directory, and doing `preload([files[0])`, similar to what is done in [the Godot docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/3.1/classes/class_directory.html). However, with the drag and drop method you can chop and change what is in the array really easily at any time, without all resources needing to be in 1 folder.
